_hinweis: Output texts in English. Do not translate placeholders in curly braces. Missing texts fall back to German (de.json).

bericht.art_probelauf: Dry run, no lasting changes to the data
bericht.unvollstaendig: {quelle:<24} INCOMPLETE new {neu:>5}  changed {geaendert:>5}  deleted {geloescht:>5}  unchanged {unveraendert:>5}  (gaps in the retrieval, will be retried)
bericht.katalog_fehlt: Note: {view} does not exist in this database, catalogue not refreshed
bericht.katalog_keine_materialized_view: Note: {view} is not a materialized view, not refreshed
bericht.katalog_ausstehend: WARNING: catalogue {view} not yet refreshed (refresh still running when this report was written, or aborted)
bericht.katalog_exklusiv: (exclusively, readers of the view wait meanwhile; a concurrent refresh needs a unique index on the view)
bericht.katalog_zeitgrenze: (time limit {zeitgrenze}; the next run retries the refresh)
bericht.leerlieferung_ungenutzt: NOTE: empty-delivery approval for {quelle} not used, {warum}: {grund}
bericht.umfang_ungenutzt: NOTE: scope confirmation for {quelle} not used, {warum}

meldung.an_unbekannt: unknown (capabilities not reachable), add `kontakt` to the configuration

verzeichnis.hinweis: Rewritten after every import run. Do not edit by hand.
verzeichnis.kopf: | Source | Type | Provider | Contact | Licence | Last successful retrieval | Objects | Last run |

karte.art_probelauf: Dry run (no lasting changes to the data)
karte.unter: What this run changed per source. Tap a name to jump there.
karte.springen: Jump to the changes of this source
karte.ohne_grund: No background map: the page loads nothing from the network. Enable with karte.hintergrund in the configuration.
